blocks.body:
Long hair, children, and the kind of colour that looks like it grew that way — that is where I am happiest. I trained in Istanbul and Zürich, and the second taught me patience: a good blow-dry is twenty quiet minutes, not ten loud ones.

If it is your child's first haircut, book me. I have crayons, I have time, and I have never once finished a cut on a crying child.
blocks.title: Elif Demir
